profile.name: Aakrit Sharma Lamsal
profile.role: Software engineering · Applied AI · Data science
profile.intro: I build AI-powered applications and the software around them. My work spans language models, retrieval-augmented generation, backend services, and data workflows — from early experiments to production integration.
profile.about: I am pursuing an M.S. in Computer Science at Georgia State University, where I also serve as a Graduate Teaching Assistant for Programming and Web Development. I bring more than three years of software engineering experience across Intralinks and MAGNUS Consulting. I enjoy translating research into working systems and collaborating across engineering, data science, and product teams.

focus.title: Applied AI
focus.text: LLM applications, RAG pipelines, NLP, and model training and evaluation.

focus.title: Software engineering
focus.text: Backend APIs, microservices, document workflows, and production integration.

focus.title: Data & experimentation
focus.text: Data preparation, machine learning experiments, and interactive prototypes.

experience.summary: Teaching assistantship for Programming and Web Development.
Internal applications, application security, and event-driven features.
highlights: Led the development and deployment of an internal document management application with SonarQube integration.
Implemented security features using Spring Security.
Developed iterative features for tracker application using events and listeners to enhance review efficiency.

experience.summary: AI models, services, and the pipelines that connect them to products.
highlights: Developed AI-driven applications in Python and helped integrate AI components into production systems.
Spearheaded end-to-end RAG development and received the “Invaluable member” award for multi-lingual Ranked RAG chat application.
Built model-layer APIs and pipelines in a microservices architecture, including workflows backed by vector databases for enhancing AI capabilities for users.
Reviewed research, experimented with company data, and trained, tested, and validated AI models using various SOTA LLM evaluation techniques.
Created proof-of-concept dashboards with Streamlit, Gradio, and Flask, working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers.

experience.summary: A translation service prototype for a core product.
highlights: Built a translation repository supporting page text and attributes in 18 languages.
Used React, MongoDB, and Express to handle page data and company-provided translation terms.
Presented the working solution to development teams and key stakeholders.

projects.title: Resume Analyzer 101
projects.summary: An interactive application that compares a resume with a target role and provides tailored feedback.
details: Accepts a PDF resume and a job description.
Uses Gemini through LangChain to identify strengths, gaps, and possible improvements.
Supports follow-up questions about the resume.

projects.title: Agentic Chat Assistant
projects.summary: An LLM application exploring tool-assisted news retrieval and structured information extraction.
details: Connects an LLM workflow with article-retrieval tools.
Extracts article information and presents structured results.
Explores practical agent workflows around a concrete information-gathering task.

projects.title: Computer Vision Lab
projects.summary: An interactive Streamlit workspace for implementing and inspecting computer vision assignments.
details: Coursework for CSC 8830 at Georgia State University.
Organizes assignments into separate modules behind a shared interface.
Provides a browser-based workflow for running and examining assignment outputs.

projects.title: Document Text Extraction
projects.summary: A browser-based OCR tool that extracts text from scanned PDFs and image files.
details: Supports image files and scanned or image-based PDFs.
Includes image preprocessing before OCR.
Uses progress indicators to guide document processing.

projects.title: Object Detection Explorer
projects.summary: An image-based object detector that presents predicted objects with bounding boxes.
details: Runs YOLO object detection on an input image.
Displays detected objects and their bounding boxes in an interactive interface.

projects.title: News Text Classification
projects.summary: A classical machine learning workflow for classifying news into five subject categories.
details: Compares tree-based models including Random Forest, Extra Trees, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost.
Classifies politics, sport, technology, entertainment, and business articles.
Includes training, testing, plotting, and a final model workflow for inference.

projects.title: Open-Source AI Playground
projects.summary: A Gradio interface for demonstrating and exploring open-source models from Hugging Face.
details: Brings model demonstrations into a shared interactive interface.
Explores accessible UI patterns for trying AI models.

projects.title: Sales Insights Dashboard
projects.summary: A sales analytics project connecting SQL data preparation with an interactive Power BI dashboard.
details: Inspects sales data for duplicate rows, invalid quantities, and inconsistent currencies.
Uses Power Query transformations and table relationships to prepare the data.
Builds charts, cards, and slicers to communicate sales insights.

publications.contribution: Reviewed more than 115 research papers as part of the literature review.
